Segnala offerta di lavoro About Us We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence. As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations. About Energy Systems We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry. About The Role At DNV, our Digital & Data Solutions (DDS) business combines deep industry expertise with advanced analytics, software, and digital technologies to help customers become more efficient, resilient, and sustainable. We develop data-driven solutions that enable renewable energy owners and operators to maximize asset performance, improve operational efficiency, and accelerate the energy transition. We're looking for a commercially driven Sales Business Developer to expand our presence and support growth across Southern Europe, with high focus on the Italian market. This is a strategic business development role focused on building long-term customer relationships, managing complex sales opportunities, and driving market development for our portfolio of renewable energy monitoring and analytics solutions. This role is based at any of the listed DNV's offices in Italy and combines customer engagement, market development, and solution-based selling. Travel is primarily linked to customer meetings, industry events, and international business activities, averaging approximately one week per month. What You’ll Do As Sales Business Developer, you will be responsible for developing business opportunities and managing the full sales lifecycle for DNV's digital solutions within the renewable energy sector. You Will Drive business development across the region by identifying, developing, and converting new commercial opportunities. Build and maintain trusted relationships with renewable energy developers, owners, operators, EPCs, and asset managers, ensuring long-term partnership development. Lead complex consultative sales processes, from initial engagement through proposal development, negotiation, and contract execution. Act as a trusted advisor, helping customers understand how digital technologies, analytics, and monitoring solutions can improve operational and commercial performance. Collaborate with technical specialists and solution experts to develop tailored proposals for the clients. Represent DNV at industry conferences, exhibitions, and renewable energy events in Italy and abroad. Provide market intelligence and customer insights to regional and global stakeholders to support business strategy and product development. Contribute to annual sales planning, forecasting, and achievement of the team’s commercial targets. Reporting directly to the Europe Regional Manager, you will play a key role in shaping DNV's market presence and growth strategy in the region. What we offer Work with a highly engaged team in an environment where trust and teamwork are core values. A job in a hybrid working model with a home base in any of the listed DNV offices. A working week of 37.5 hours (for candidates located in Italy). An attractive benefit package depending on the country of employment. Continuous training and professional improvement opportunities. A position at the heart of innovation in the green energy industry For candidates located in Italy: salary range between €45.000 and €55.000 gross per year. DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity. About You We are interested in speaking with professionals who combine strong commercial instincts with the ability to build credibility in technical conversations. To Succeed In This Role, You Will Bring A bachelor's degree in engineering, energy, business, or another relevant discipline. Fluent Italian and English communication skills, both written and spoken. At least 5 years of experience in business development, solution sales, account management, or commercial roles within renewable energy, power, industrial software, automation, or related sectors, including proven experience in managing complex B2B sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and long decision-making processes. Experience selling technology, software, digital solutions, industrial systems, or technical services. A strong professional network within the Italian renewable energy market. Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills. A strategic and consultative sales approach focused on creating long-term customer value. This Role Will Suit You If You Enjoy building business relationships more than high-volume transactional selling. Prefer managing key customer opportunities rather than spending most of your time travelling between sites. Are comfortable working from an office and collaborating closely with colleagues across Europe. Want to be part of the digital transformation of the renewable energy industry. Thrive in an international environment with exposure to customers and stakeholders across multiple markets. Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices. About this Job Location: Milan, Italy (Hybrid – 3 days/week in the office, 2 remote) Type: Full-time – with a clear path to Head of Marketing About Flottando Company cars are boring. We need someone crazy enough to make them exciting. 🚗 At Flottando we build AI software for corporate fleets. That means invoices, multe, fringe benefits, contract renewals and the Excel files that HR, Procurement and Finance trade back and forth every month. Hundreds of Italian companies already use us, and many of them are happy to tell their story. Now we need someone to go out and tell it, loudly. The role Let's be honest about this role. There's no marketing team waiting for you, no agency, no big budget and no brand guidelines. There's you, a laptop, a small and hungry founding team, and a product customers love. You'll write the post, film the video, book the guest, run the webinar, set up the event booth, send the follow-ups, and check on Monday whether any of it turned into pipeline. Then you'll do it again, better. If that sounds exhausting, this isn't for you. If it sounds like the best job ever, keep reading. Where this goes 🚀 You start as our first marketer. As Flottando grows in Italy and expands into Europe, you grow with it: you'll hire the team, own the budget and become our Head of Marketing. We're not hiring someone to fill a seat. We're looking for the person who will lead marketing here. What you will do • Call happy customers and turn them into case studies, videos and LinkedIn posts, starting in week one • Run our social channels yourself: writing, filming, editing, posting • Organize webinars and events from scratch, including topic, speakers, promotion, hosting and follow-up • Generate leads, hand them to sales, and track what becomes revenue • Launch our new AI products and make people understand why they matter • Do our employer branding so great people want to join us • Test, measure, kill what doesn't work and double down on what does • Challenge the founders. The CEO sets the strategy, and you push back when the data says otherwise Here's an example. In a demo, a fleet manager says she used to spend three days a month building cost reports in Excel. You hear it. You call her, record a 60-second video, turn it into a LinkedIn post, build a webinar around it, and check two weeks later how many demos it brought in. That's the mindset we're looking for. Who we are looking for You're probably a great fit if: • You're hands-on: you've done the work yourself, not just managed others doing it • You love startups: chaos, speed and building from zero excite you • You're entrepreneurial: you don't wait for a brief, a budget or permission. You ship • You're analytical: you care about leads and revenue, not likes • You're a strong communicator in writing, on camera and on stage • You're creative enough to make fleet management fun (yes, really) • You're high-energy and positive. People leave a call with you smiling Requirements • At least 1 year of hands-on experience in digital marketing with B2B SaaS products • Strong expertise in content marketing, SEO and GEO (getting found on Google and in AI answers like ChatGPT and Perplexity) • Strong experience with HubSpot: workflows, lead tracking, reporting • Native Italian, fluent in English • Bonus: experience at an early-stage startup or scale-up What we offer • RAL: 25k–38k EUR based on experience • A clear path to Head of Marketing, earned by results rather than seniority • Huge ownership from day one • A direct line to the founders, with no layers in between • AI at the foundation of our product, not as a buzzword • The chance to help build Italy's leading fleet platform and take it to Europe • A hybrid setup, with 3 days per week in our Milan office Hiring process We like to keep things simple, fast, and transparent. 01. Intro Call – 30 minutes Meet one of the founders. We'll talk about your motivation, what you've built so far, and what you're looking for. 02. Practical Case A short, real challenge: show us how you'd make Flottando impossible to ignore in the next 60-90 days from day 1 u join us. 03. Final Interview – 45 minutes: Walk us through your case with the CEO and the team. 04. Offer We aim to complete the process within 2–6 weeks. One last thing: We can teach you fleets, fringe benefits and how fines management work. What we're really looking for is harder to teach: Hunger. Ownership. Creativity. And the instinct to ship. If you read this and thought "finally, a job where I can just build," we'd love to meet you. Join Flottando and help us make fleet management exciting. Acting as the face of the vendor internally and externally, the VSM builds trust-based relationships with vendor executives, partners, and internal teams while ensuring governance, compliance, and operational excellence. Success requires proactive engagement, strong commercial acumen, and the ability to influence both vendor and internal stakeholders. Vendor Relationship Management * Act as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for assigned vendors. * Build and maintain multi-level relationships across vendor sales, marketing, and operations. * Represent Westcon-Comstor at vendor headquarters, events, and strategic meetings. * Cascade vendor objectives internally to ensure alignment and execution. Business Planning & Execution * Develop and own the Vendor Market Plan with clear objectives, targets, and enablement actions. * Deliver revenue, margin, and profitability goals across the vendor portfolio. * Deploy campaigns, promotions, and investments at local level; adjust plans based on performance. * Provide structured progress updates to management and vendor counterparts. Sales Enablement & Acceleration * Train sales teams on vendor products, tools, and programs to ensure commercial readiness. * Drive adoption of vendor programs by partners and internal teams. * Identify and remove growth blockers to accelerate deal velocity. Pipeline Stimulation & Demand Generation * Generate new opportunities through campaigns, account mapping, and joint planning. * Track active deals with IAMs and PSMs to ensure timely closure. * Support vendor-specific sales blitzes and digital initiatives (Power BI, 3DLab). Partner Engagement & Development * Identify and recruit new vendor-aligned partners; manage focus accounts jointly with PSMs. * Support partner enablement through certifications, rebates, and program participation. * Monitor partner performance and adjust plans to meet vendor objectives. Marketing & MDF Governance * Execute vendor campaigns and ensure brand consistency across all communications. * Maximize MDF impact through ROI-driven planning and transparent reporting. * Represent vendor and Westcon-Comstor at trade shows, events, and joint partner activities. Forecasting & Reporting * Provide accurate forecasts for vendor sales and margin projections. * Track performance versus targets and analyze trends to adapt strategies. * Maintain CRM discipline and timely reporting for governance compliance. Compliance & Program Governance * Ensure adherence to vendor requirements, processes, and ethical standards. * Manage MDF responsibly, ensuring transparency and audit readiness. Must-Have Skills & Experience * Proven experience in vendor management, channel sales, or business development roles. * Strong commercial acumen and ability to influence vendor and internal stakeholders. * Excellent relationship-building and negotiation skills. * Language: Italian & English (business fluency). Nice-to-Have Skills & Experience * Familiarity with multi-vendor IT distribution and channel ecosystems. * Experience in marketing campaign execution and MDF governance. * Additional languages and international exposure. Education & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or related field (or equivalent experience). Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) * Vendor revenue and margin attainment at country/cluster level. * Market share growth and pipeline coverage ratio (≥3× target). * Partner recruitment and activation metrics. * Campaign execution and MDF ROI. * Training and enablement impact (sales readiness and certification rates). * Forecast accuracy and CRM data quality. * Vendor satisfaction scores and governance compliance.
